lines.text: You and I may be sharing a battlefield, but that doesn't make us equals.
What a pathetic bunch of fools.
I leave my dreams in your hands.
You must never betray me. Never.
Not too keen on being called weakling? How about squirt, then?
Now is no time to be playing around.
Well, don't just stand there like some statue! Do you realize how lucky you are that I'm giving you the time of day?
A true commander never neglects the armory.
What am I reading? Intel for the next assignment.
I'll accept nothing less than perfection from my team.
Words alone won't get you to the top.
... Are you trying to bribe me?
I just saw possibilities in you.
You truly are a puny thing, but you make it work.
You'd better not try to leave me as those scumbags did. I've chosen you.
I can't defy orders, can I?
Time to show these amateurs how it's done.
I'll put a bullet in every last stinkin' one of you.
Damn it... I'll let you take over from here.
